sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What is the main difference between galloping and skipping?
options: A) Galloping has a lead foot, skipping alternates feet
B) Skipping is only done backwards
questions.answer: A) Galloping has a lead foot, skipping alternates feet

questions.question_text: In Pitthou (Lagori), where should defenders aim when throwing the ball at opponents?
options: B) Below the waist/at the legs
questions.answer: B) Below the waist/at the legs

questions.question_text: What happens to your heart rate when you rest after a game?
options: C) It slows down to a normal resting pace
questions.answer: C) It slows down to a normal resting pace

options: B) Concentrating your mind on one thought or breath
questions.answer: B) Concentrating your mind on one thought or breath

questions.question_text: Why do defenders aim below the waist in tagging games with balls?
options: B) Because the rules don't matter
C) To ensure safety and prevent head or face injuries
questions.answer: C) To ensure safety and prevent head or face injuries

questions.question_text: Admitting you are out even when the referee didn't see it is an example of:
How do you calm a racing mind before a big match?
In a relay race, pacing is important so you don't:
options: A) Run out of energy too early
questions.answer: A) Run out of energy too early

questions.question_text: Explain the movement of a gallop.
questions.answer: Step forward with one foot, then bring the back foot up to meet the front foot, keeping the same foot in the lead.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to aim for the legs when tagging someone with a ball in Lagori?
questions.answer: It is safer to hit the lower body; hitting the face or chest can cause injury or pain.

questions.question_text: What does it mean to have 'integrity' in a game?
questions.answer: Integrity means playing fair, following rules, and being honest about mistakes or getting tagged, even when no one is watching.

questions.question_text: Why is taking a rest after heavy physical activity important?
questions.answer: Rest allows your heart rate to normalize, cools down your body, and gives your muscles time to recover.

questions.question_text: How does concentrating on your breathing help you physically?
questions.answer: It slows down the heart rate, relaxes tight muscles, and clears the mind.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: The rhythm of skipping is a continuous pattern of a _______ followed by a _______ on the same foot, alternating sides.
Match the sportsmanship action to the scenario: 1) Shaking hands, 2) Owning up to a tag. Options: A) When the referee misses the play, B) At the end of a match.
questions.answer: 1 matches with B, 2 matches with A

questions.question_text: During Lagori, a ball grazes your leg, but the referee didn't see it. Your team needs you to win. What do you do?
questions.answer: I will raise my hand and honestly tell the referee that I was hit. Winning by cheating isn't a real victory, and honesty shows true sportsmanship.

questions.question_text: Design a fun 'Locomotor Relay Race' for 4 players.
questions.answer: Player 1 runs to the cone and back. Player 2 gallops to the cone and back. Player 3 skips to the cone and back. Player 4 hops on one foot to the cone and runs back. The first team to finish sits down.
